ValidationRule.description: CC-5112 Prevent BirthDate is in Future
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'PersonAccount', NOT(ISNULL(PersonBirthdate)), (ISNEW() || ISCHANGED(PersonBirthdate)), PersonBirthdate > TODAY() )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Date of Birth cannot be in the future.
